text_block_list.name: Elderly Storekeeper
text_block_list.text:
Thanks so much for helping my son and<n>his wife
with their move.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Don't mention it! You're always doing so<n>much for
us, after all.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
I didn't think we'd have everything done<n>by noon,
but having two people on it<n>really helped speed
things along.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, we sure like to compete a whole<n>lot, but
working together like this isn't<n>too bad, huh?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Heh. Well, if we were always<n>cooperating like
this, I'd get thrown off<n>my game.

text_block_list.name: Elderly Storekeeper
text_block_list.text:
Oh, that's right. I'm sure I've got some<n>ohagi
cakes around here, so why don't<n>you eat those
before you head home?

text_block_list.name: Elderly Storekeeper
text_block_list.text:
...Oh, looks like there's three left. I've<n>only just
had breakfast, so you two share<n>them between
yourselves.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Take two of them, Vodka. I'm sure<n>you're tired
after carrying that big chest<n>of drawers.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
No, no, you were the one lugging that<n>fridge
around. You should take two.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Oh, that was no trouble at all. You must<n>be more
fatigued than me. I definitely<n>heard you let out a
sigh after you were<n>done.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Um, sorry? Who was the one grunting<n>and trying
to psyche herself up the<n>whole time?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
That was just for encouragement! I was<n>saying
"Phew!" to sympathize with you<n>after all that
physical labor you endured!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Now you're splitting hairs! That was<n>nowhere near
enough work to tire me<n>out! Just hurry up and
take them!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: I'll have you know that I'm not tired inthe least! They're all yours, Vodka!

text_block_list.name: Vodka & Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Grrrrr!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Just glaring at each other won't get us<n>anywhere!
Let's compete to see who's<n>more worn out!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Very well! How about a one-lap race<n>around the
neighborhood then?!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Bring it on! This spot's the finish line!<n>Whoever's
more tired by the end gets<n>the extra cake!

text_block_list.name: Vodka & Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Rrrraaaagh!

text_block_list.name: Elderly Storekeeper
text_block_list.text:
...Goodness. It's nice that they're so full<n>of
energy.
